### Sugset – Paneer Dodi Phool 175g | Traditional Ayurvedic Herbal Blend for Everyday Wellness

Rooted in the timeless wisdom of Ayurveda, Sugset – Paneer Dodi Phool is a carefully curated blend of hand-harvested flowers from the pristine slopes of the Himalayas and Kashmir valley. Known traditionally as Paneer Dodi, these delicate blooms have been cherished for generations as part of daily ritualistic practices in holistic well-being.

Each batch is gently dried and minimally processed to preserve the natural integrity of the herb, offering a pure, unadulterated form ideal for infusion in water. The soft, morsel-like texture allows for easy preparation, making it a gentle addition to your morning routine.

#### Traditional Preparation
To prepare, simply soak 10–15 pieces of Paneer Dodi Phool in a glass of clean, room-temperature water overnight. In the morning, gently squeeze the softened flowers to release their essence into the water. Consume the infused water on an empty stomach, as part of a mindful daily practice.

#### Why Choose Sugset?
- Sourced from high-altitude regions where the plant thrives in natural, unpolluted conditions
- Hand-selected and sun-dried using age-old methods
- Free from additives, preservatives, or artificial processing
- Packaged in a resealable pouch to maintain freshness and potency

A cherished element in traditional home wellness rituals, Sugset invites you to connect with nature’s rhythm through simple, daily care.

---

Note: This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. It is offered as a traditional herbal preparation in alignment with Ayurvedic principles for general wellness support.
